description: Entity correction dictionary for auto-generated transcripts (Whisper/Zoom/xxx). Maps each canonical entity to (a) 'variants' = genuine mis-spellings safe to auto-fix to the correct PLAIN-TEXT name, and (b) 'ambiguous_variants' = risky tokens that must only be FLAGGED for human confirmation. Grow this file as new mangling patterns are observed.

rules.correct: Canonical plain-text spelling. Confident replacements rewrite a variant to THIS string. Never list the correct spelling itself as a variant (it needs no fixing and would re-match).
rules.variants: Distinctive mis-spellings that are NOT real English words, do not collide with any other entity, and are unambiguously this entity. Auto-replaced with 'correct' on --write, matched case-insensitively on whole-word boundaries. Leave empty when no safe garble exists.
rules.ambiguous_variants: Risky tokens that MIGHT be this entity: single letters, real English words, first-names shared by several people, common pronouns/nouns. NEVER auto-replaced — only reported with file:line so a human decides. Never seed a common word (e.g. 'you').
rules.wikilink: The exact resolved [[slug|Display]] form. Shown in the report so the ingest step (or reviewer) can link the confirmed mention. Reuse the form that already exists in the wiki; never invent a slug. Leave EMPTY when the vault has no page for the entity — an empty wikilink means 'correct the spelling, keep it plain text'.
rules.type: person | product | system | team | term — informational. 'term' covers domain vocabulary that is not a proper noun but is still mangled in a load-bearing way (e.g. 'hard delay' -> 'hard delete').
rules.note: Free text. Record confirmed-but-not-auto-replaceable resolutions here.
rules.known_noise: Top-level list of name-shaped tokens confirmed to mean nobody. The script ignores this key; it exists so the skill's manual sweep does not re-ask about them. Only add a token the user has confirmed is noise — a merely UNRESOLVED name stays out, so it gets surfaced again next time.
